title: [29.X]-Sales Order line quantities are incorrectly updated after posting a Return Order linked to a Posted Sales Invoice via Applies-to Doc. No. on a Credit Memo
summary: The correct posted sales invoice functionality now properly handles return orders linked to posted sales invoices through applies-to document numbers on credit memos, fixing incorrect line quantity updates.
key_points: Corrects quantity update logic when return orders reference posted sales invoices via applies-to field
Addresses issue where sales order line quantities were incorrectly modified after posting
Includes test coverage for the copy purchase and sales documents functionality
Changes applied across multiple localization layers (W1, ES, APAC)
